official_site_checks: The official homepage currently renders the Daily Top Rated Today and Yesterday gallery links and thumbnails server-side; its JavaScript only toggles their visibility locally. The Home parser exposes both picks as one-entry scrollers without extra requests. Live official /languages/ and /languages/popular/ directories each expose 26 language classifications. Sample /language/english/ Latest and Popular page-1/page-2 routes returned HTTP 200. Live site routes also confirm /tag/<slug>/ and /tag/<slug>/popular/, including paginated Popular /popular/pag/2/. The three official sidebar POST routes top_faved, top_fapped and top_downloaded each return HTTP 200 and current div.item gallery markup through the same XHR/CSRF request shape used by the source. Regression tests cover the daily picks, language directory parsing, route sorting and pagination, quick-select and freeform taxonomy routing, browsable Home scrollers, and independent handling of failed sidebar markup. Version 21 adds separate Latest and Popular dynamic listings for popular tags; fixtures check listing IDs and route selection.
